title: New Zealand man is shown a map of knowledge of everything and remembers some interesting details

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Awareness in a vast black void “somewhere else completely” with no physical body sensation; later hovering above a vast ‘floor/terrain’ of interlocking tiles (“map of knowledge”).
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported progression from “absolute fear” to “limitless bliss, love and elation, free of any sense of self,” then emotionless void; later intense humming/ringing and ‘electric current’ bodily sensation during knowledge ‘download.’

arrival.other_being_detail: An emotionless, practical ‘helper/interactive librarian’ presence sensed nearby; later a ‘real voice’ (wife) called his name; sensed ‘hand in my hand’ and another on forearm.

environment.environment_other_detail: Primary setting: “vast… black void of endless vivid infinite nothing,” later a vast ‘floor/terrain’ of giant interlocking matte-black tiles like jigsaw pieces; occasional ‘shimmering walls’; horizon edged with different ‘light’ intensity; later ‘vibrant and sharp… colour, contrast and auras’ on return.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Urgent external call/command from wife (“Come back!”) plus recognition of bodily distress/pain and sense he was “on the edge of death, no return.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred while resting in bed after neck injury/overexertion; described panic, numbness, loss of bodily sensation; later diagnosed spinal disc issues/stenosis/syrinx.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated ‘entering’ knowledge ‘pieces/tiles’ with massive information transfer; sensed ‘map of knowledge of everything’; bodily crisis interrupts; wife’s voice/hand sensation prompts return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel/light/life review. Progression: bodily numbness → void → appearance of ‘terrain/tiles’ → sensed presence + telepathic info exchange → repeated immersion into ‘pieces’ (knowledge downloads) → bodily distress → external voice/hand sensation → choice/command to return → rapid re-entry with severe pain and aftereffects.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated cycles of moving into/out of different ‘pieces’ of knowledge, returning to the void between them.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reports parallel processing (“dozens of complex thoughts all at the same time”), and ‘massive parallel pulse’ of understanding/visions/logic arriving all at once.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Central motif is a vast ‘jigsaw-tile’ terrain described as a ‘map of knowledge of everything’ with interactive, AI-like telepathic Q&A; repeated ‘entering’ tiles to receive encyclopedic ‘downloads’ (universe age ~14 billion years; quantum physics; explanations of concepts like aliens/ghosts/water memory; claim of ‘546 years humanity had left’). Strongly ‘emotionless practicality’ tone; later an urgent external voice (wife) and sensed hands trigger return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "a vast empty, stark, intense black void of endless vivid infinite nothing"; "a map of knowledge of everything"; "a pure information transfer"; "like an AI response"; "Come back!"; "it felt as if I were now somewhere else completely"; "oddly felt more real than physical reality".
